text:
rachel: Morning — NimbusHealth dedicated pilot update.

What I did: closed contract, scheduled infra kickoff, shared onboarding doc.
Blockers: customer asking about HSM integration for KMS, needs assurance on key wrap & rotation; legal asking for network/data flow diagram.
Today: need eng/security confirmation on HSM key wrapping support and timeframe for an on-prem connector demo.

sam: thanks rachel. can you paste the specific HSM vendor? Nimbus mentioned Thales Luna.

rachel: yes Thales Luna 7. asked for attestation + CPI. They want HSM in their VPC, keys never leave HSM. also asked if Redwood can support bring-your-own-key (BYOK) + automatic rotation.

anya (security): @rachel we need an explicit data flow diagram and list of outputs that might leave customer network. also confirm EKM/BYOK policy. I'll prep the checklist. ETA EOD.

eng-ryan: @anya @rachel we support KMS integrations via our KMS adapter; for BYOK we currently support external HSM via KMIP and cloud KMS connectors. We do not ship an on-prem HSM appliance. For keywrap semantics we use AES-KW (RFC3394) + RSA-OAEP for wrap to cloud backups. I'll drop the PR with docs — PR #842.

sam: @ryan any blocker to demoing a VM in their VPC? Nimbus wants a "show me it works" session next week.

eng-ryan: latency-wise fine. Need infra help to provision a test subnet & route. @infra-ops can you help with provisioning sandbox in us-east-1, small VM & VPN endpoint? Should be ~1-2 days.

infra-ops: on it. need the CIDR & contact for tunnelling. Pinged @rachel offline for details.

security-bot: Security checklist required: Data Flow Diagram, Threat Model, Key Management Plan, Audit Log retention. Link: https://redwood.internal/security/checklists/nimbus

rachel: noted. I'm compiling customer SSO matrix (Okta) and onboarding SOW. @legal I'll send the network diagram once anya approves.

eng-ryan: quick note — PR #842 references a config snippet:
```
kms_adapter:
  provider: thales-luna
  mode: kmip
  wrap_algo: AES-KW
```
Can someone from docs sweep for public-facing wording? prefer "HSM-backed keys via KMIP" rather than vendor names.

anya: docs note sounds good. I'll review PR today.

sam: Sales ask: can we get confirmation on SLA for Dedicated pilot? Nimbus expects 99.9 latency SLA and 24/7 support for pilot week.

rachel: already flagged to @acct-mgr. @product any objections to temporary elevated support during pilot?

product-oliver: we can do a pilot SLA for one week with on-call rotation, but need eng to commit on rollback policy if perf degrades. propose 2 model fallbacks and pre-warmed capacity.

eng-ryan: agree. we'll prep two fallbacks: smaller model + quantized variant. need to test fallbacks in staging.

rachel: action items: (1) @anya security checklist by EOD; (2) @eng-ryan PR #842 + staging fallback tests by Thursday; (3) @infra-ops sandbox provision 48hrs; (4) @product confirm pilot SLA doc.

sam: great — I'll update Nimbus and schedule the demo for next Thurs. Thanks team :tada:

rachel: thanks all. I'll post final sync notes here.
